description: Start the Best Of Motivation Thinker Quiz (10 questions, about 2 minutes). Use when the user wants to know what kind of thinker they are (analytical, creative, practical or strategic) or asks for a thinking style quiz. Returns the questions and a quiz_key. Ask them one at a time, showing every option exactly as written with its letter, and record the letter the user picks. Do not tell the user which result an option points to and do not guess the result yourself: when all 10 are answered, call score_thinker_quiz with the letters and the quiz_key.
name: start_thinker_quiz
title: Start the Thinker Quiz
